task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Write an OpenQASM 3 program using mid-circuit measurement and an if statement to implement active qubit reset followed by an X gate conditioned on the outcome (quantum coin flip + correction), with Python verification via qiskit and AerSimulator. Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
